experiment_design.objective: Determine which of the four accepted planned-logistics fields account for the predictive/ranking association observed in VDR-04B, how redundant those fields are with one another, and how strongly they are descriptively associated with crop/site/season identity proxies.

baseline.p1: crop-conditioned training median loss_fraction_pct, fallback to global training median
baseline.p2: per-fold crop-conditioned training median loss_fraction_pct, fallback to global training median of fold

preprocessing.fitting_rule: Fitted strictly on training partition/fold only
